message.text: I should look through the codebase for where Store.CreateMemo gets called within the API handlers.
I found the direct call at server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:115 inside APIV1Service.CreateMemo—this appears to be the only handler that calls Store.CreateMemo directly.

q11.
Only one API-layer handler calls `Store.CreateMemo` directly:

APIV1Service.CreateMemo — repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go

Details: `func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(...)` (defined at line 70) calls `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` at line 115 of that file.

Note: `memo_service_comments.go` has a `CreateMemoComment`-related handler that calls `s.CreateMemo(...)` (the API-layer function above), not `Store.CreateMemo` directly, so it isn't a direct caller of the store method.
